observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the same white Xbox One S console with a black controller on top.
The console has a perforated front panel and a visible disc slot on the left side.
The controller has the standard Xbox design with colored face buttons (A, B, X, Y) and a central guide button.
The console appears to be in used condition with some minor scuffs and wear visible on the surface.
The background is a plain blue wall, and the photos are taken from slightly different angles.
No games, cables, or accessories are visible in the photos.
The seller claims 8 offline games and one original Xbox One S wireless controller.
